attr.title: Cortex Command
attr.desc: A 2D side-scrolling action-strategy sandbox with fully destructible, pixel-simulated terrain. Command a brain in a jar, buy and dig in your troops, drop ships full of reinforcements and fight for gold. This is the open-source Cortex Command Community Project.
attr.inst: Ready to run, no additional files needed. The first launch extracts the game data, which takes a few minutes.
